verdicts.reason: Both have the same flaws: SOLSTICE is enlarged to compete with the headline and placed below it, the CTA sits above the badges instead of after them, and the green background circle has slid to the bottom-left corner where it peeks out awkwardly behind the 'Summer Only' pill. A is slightly worse because its headline and wordmark nearly touch both canvas edges and its pills are oversized. B keeps marginally better side margins and has tidier, centred pills.
